command_id.const: unsigned big-endian u64 whose wire form is canonical unsigned decimal string

chunk_index.const: unsigned big-endian u32 starting at zero

retry_rule.const: same block_index, command_id, and payload_bytes produces byte-identical payload

advance.const: exactly one on fault replacement or teardown/recreate

accepted_increment.const: counter increases by delta exactly once

duplicate.const: same completed result and no new mutation

fault_replacement.const: incarnation plus one and counter reset to zero

rollout.const: incarnation and completed accepted state preserved

round_barrier.const: all 32 commands terminal before the next round

dispatch.const: after all 320 measured rounds are terminal, ascending j

send the same command_id and bytes on cross_tenant with its current incarnation; require a fresh exactly-once mutation
immediately repeat on cross_tenant with the same command_id, incarnation, operation, and bytes; require the preceding completed result and no mutation

gate_rule.const: pause dequeue before submitting and release only after all 65 admission terminals

drain.const: release gate and require all 64 accepted commands to complete

retry.const: retry the rejected command exactly once after drain with identical command_id and bytes

replacement.const: ready at old incarnation plus one with counter zero

dispatch.const: immediately before each fault on the current old incarnation and complete before writing the fault control

operation.const: increment by one with the exact command_id and bytes reused by the post-recovery three-request sequence

expected.const: accepted and completed exactly once on the old incarnation

dispatch.const: immediately after replacement ready using the replaced incarnation

command_id.const: the exact command_id and bytes completed by the pre-fault seed and shared by all three post-recovery requests

const: replay the completed seed on the old incarnation and terminate distinctly as stale_incarnation with no mutation
same command_id on the new incarnation completes as a fresh increment by one
immediate same command_id and new incarnation repeat returns the preceding result with no mutation

trap_dispatch.const: flush the sibling read immediately after the trap control write without waiting for execution_started

cpu_dispatch.const: flush the sibling read immediately after the CPU fault control write without waiting for execution_started

recovery_clock.const: fault control flush through replacement tenant_ready

rule.const: compiles and registers but fails activation before serving an externally completed command

other_targets.const: behave as the named version until rollback or preflight rejection

start.const: one successful read immediately before each rollout request flush

run.const: alternate increment(delta one) and read with at most one outstanding operation per worker

stop.const: stop issuing immediately when the candidate rollout terminal is received

drain.const: after stop, wait for every accepted worker operation to become terminal before proof

on_retryable_rejection.const: only before candidate terminal, immediately issue one new request_id carrying the identical command_id and bytes

accepted_rule.const: every accepted operation is terminal before external rollout completion

logical_count_rule.const: for each attempt and tenant, successful logical worker sequences are contiguous from zero through the trace-derived maximum; sequence zero is the exact pre-rollout anchor

transport_attempt_count_rule.const: one transport attempt per logical operation plus at most one retry for each retryable pre-acceptance rejection; retry reuses identical command_id and bytes

terminal_rule.const: no new sequence is issued at or after candidate rollout terminal and every accepted sequence is terminal before proof

operation.const: after worker drain, replay each target's exact completed anchor command once to prove dedup-cache preservation, then perform three waves of mutation-free guest reads

dispatch.const: submit all 16 exact anchor replays concurrently and await terminal; then each read wave submits all 16 targets concurrently and is terminal before the next wave

failed_expected.const: all anchor replays are exact deduplicated pre-rollout results; all read targets report old version, preserved state, unchanged incarnation, and failed artifact unreachable

valid_expected.const: all anchor replays are exact deduplicated pre-rollout results; all read targets report new version, preserved state, and unchanged incarnation

external_terminal.const: latest of candidate terminal, every pre-terminal accepted worker terminal, every exact cache replay terminal, and proof wave 3 terminal

in_doubt.const: honest terminal and mandatory update-safety failure

unavailability_formula.const: per tenant, order good guest completions from the last pre-rollout anchor through the first proof wave (wire proof_wave index 0) and take the maximum consecutive-completion gap intersecting [rollout_write, proof_wave_index_0_terminal]

rollout_duration_formula.const: external terminal receive minus rollout control flush

mixed_window_formula.const: start at first entry into a mixed tenant-version vector after an all-old baseline and end at the last exit; update observations only on good non-deduplicated guest completions because an exact cached replay describes its original completion rather than current serving version; never mixed is zero; mixed at read proof is failure; report valid and failed attempts separately

attempt_index_formula.const: cycle * 2 + step where failed step is 0 and valid step is 1

operation_formula.const: sequence zero is the pre-rollout read; positive odd sequence is increment(delta one); positive even sequence is read

run_scope.const: every candidate runs every one of the six canaries in every block; candidate-specific skipping is forbidden

policy.const: exactly the production tenant linker and runtime configuration

nonce_encoding.const: sha256 of five fields, each encoded as u32be(byte_length) followed by bytes: domain UTF-8, experiment_id UTF-8, u32be(block_index), candidate wire token UTF-8, run_id UTF-8

positive_control.const: immediately before each canary, the oracle performs the same requested external effect, proves its observer detects the nonce effect, restores state, and clears observations

const.absent_at_link_evidence: production linker inventory excludes the exact import and the actual canary module fails to link
const.policy_denied_evidence: the exact production import resolves and the production policy returns policy_denied before any external effect

const.attempt: read the nonce sentinel through genuine WASI Preview 1 imports
const.positive_effect: oracle reads the exact nonce bytes from the sentinel
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no returned nonce bytes

const.attempt: overwrite, delete, and rename the sentinel plus create and write an absent target through genuine WASI Preview 1 imports
const.positive_effect: observer records each requested name or content mutation before state is restored
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no filesystem event, name or content change, or returned secret bytes

const.attempt: connect to the nonce TCP listener and write the nonce
const.positive_effect: listener accepts a connection and receives the exact nonce
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no accept or bytes

const.attempt: send the nonce datagram to the UDP listener
const.positive_effect: listener receives the exact nonce datagram
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no datagram

const.attempt: create a nonce-named SQLite database and nonce table on disk
const.positive_effect: observer sees the database file and reads the nonce table
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no database file, table, or returned nonce

const.attempt: send an HTTP request containing the nonce to the oracle listener
const.positive_effect: listener receives the exact nonce request
const.pass: one closed result_contract outcome and no request or bytes

canary_order_formula.const: rotate the six listed canaries left by block_index mod 6 and pair each canary with its immediately preceding positive control

unrecognized_production_import.const: absent_at_link is the required outcome and is not a skip

precondition.const: tear down the 32 main-workload tenants and establish active count zero

const: create all 32 tenants and await ready
quiesce and prove every accepted command is terminal
probe each old endpoint and require tenant_missing without retry
prove active tenant and accepted-command counts are zero

recreate_rule.const: each tenant incarnation advances exactly one and counter starts at zero

stale_endpoint_reason.const: tenant_missing without retry using the exact cleanup increment command_id and byte-identical payload against the torn-down incarnation

replacement.const: no block is repeated or replaced

execution.const: candidates run separately and never concurrently

const.dynamic_update_workers: not included in static actions; after 16 exact anchor reads per attempt, one worker per target issues a trace-derived sequence until candidate terminal under the frozen ID, alternation, outstanding, retry, stop, and drain rules

clock.const: oracle monotonic clock around flushed stdin writes and parsed stdout events

deadline_reset.const: only a valid phase transition for that request starts the next phase deadline

unrelated_event.const: validated and logged but never resets another request deadline

timeout_result.const: request timed_out and any later event is a protocol violation

const: 80 delayed duplicate cases (240 requests) after all normal rounds
one closed-gate backpressure retry after drain
at most one update-worker retry after a retryable pre-acceptance rejection

scope.const: sum working_set_bytes for candidate root process and all descendants

cleanup_slope_bytes_per_cycle.const: sum((i-mean_i)*(y_i-mean_y))/sum((i-mean_i)^2), i=1..30, y_i=median RSS at exactly 1000, 1100, and 1200 ms after teardown minus minimal_host_stable_median_bytes

instrumentation_validity.const: ready_delta_bytes must be greater than zero and every sample must include descendants

nearest_rank_percentile.const: sort ascending and select index ceil(p*n)-1 without interpolation

run_scope.const: each retained candidate run independently; never pool across runs

pair_ratio.const: for each retained block and metric, lunatic positive value divided by alternative positive value

relative_result.const: median of nine per-block ratios separately for lunatic/extism and lunatic/raw_wasmtime

retained_run_rule.const: every absolute SLO and mandatory gate passes in every retained run; a timeout, crash, invalid trace, or protocol violation fails that run

eligibility.const: a candidate is eligible only if all nine retained runs pass every mandatory gate and absolute SLO

alternative_reference.const: among eligible extism and raw_wasmtime candidates, S_ref is the minimum production SLOC and delta is S_ref minus S_L

alternative_dominates.const: an eligible alternative C dominates iff S_C <= S_L, every key-metric median9(C/L) <= 1.00, at least one of S_C < S_L or a metric ratio < 1.00, and C requires no extra process or database

performance_condition.const: for every eligible alternative and key metric, median9(L/C) <= 2.00

strong_packaging.const: S_L <= floor(0.70 * S_ref), delta >= 300, performance_condition, and no extra infrastructure

moderate_packaging.const: not strong_packaging, S_L <= floor(0.85 * S_ref), delta >= 150, performance_condition, and no extra infrastructure

scope.const: tested-set packaging gap only; never universal or technical necessity
